what_cross_source_union_adds.statement: The aggregate places COD crystal records beside AFLOW and Materials Project computed structure records, exposing multiple source-qualified structural and phase candidates without treating formula identity as phase identity.

The same landscape includes 2D C2DB electronic context and bulk or three-dimensional electronic records from Materials Project and NOMAD, so the dimensionality, method, functional, and SOC context actually returned by those sources can be inspected before selecting exact follow-ups; direct, indirect, or optical gap modality remains a gap when the source does not declare it.

unsupported_declared_claim_gaps.statement: The same landscape includes 2D C2DB electronic context and bulk or three-dimensional electronic records from Materials Project and NOMAD, so the dimensionality, method, functional, and SOC context actually returned by those sources can be inspected before selecting exact follow-ups; direct, indirect, or optical gap modality remains a gap when the source does not declare it.

targets.scientific_role: Preregistered 2D p-6m2 PBE+SOC source-summary band-gap and context record; C2DB exposes no band-structure or DOS artifact route for this record.
Preregistered bulk P6_3/mmc (space group 194) exact electronic-artifact demonstration target.
Preregistered exact AFLOW 3D periodic six-site structure for one transparent structural comparison with Materials Project mp-2815; other structures are outside this method input.

researcher_use: Use the cross-source landscape to separate 2D and bulk candidates and their calculation contexts, then inspect only the preregistered exact structures and Materials Project spectral artifacts needed for the declared comparison and plots.
actionable_next_step: Any phase-resolved comparison beyond the one preregistered AFLOW-to-Materials-Project exact-structure match requires separately declared exact inputs; obtain separately identified experimental band-gap observations for an experiment-computation comparison and do not collapse this evidence to one MoS2 gap.
external_handoff: A phase-resolved experiment-computation comparison or new many-body/DFT calculation requires separately identified experimental gap data and external electronic-structure workflows over phase-matched inputs.
unresolved_gaps: This run retrieved no band-gap observation explicitly identified as experimental; COD and CODX experimental structures do not supply an experimental band gap.
The returned band-gap observations do not declare direct, indirect, or optical modality; that context remains unresolved rather than inferred.

Only the preregistered AFLOW and Materials Project exact bulk structures enter one fixed-parameter match; phase equivalence remains unresolved for every other cross-source record, the 2D C2DB target, and different polytypes.
The result is a capacity-bounded multi-source material landscape, not a phase-resolved MoS2 gap answer.
Any calculation or phase context absent from a returned source-qualified record remains unknown.

The all-qualified aggregate attempts every parsed qualified route, but fair Bundle-capacity sharing or a safety ceiling can yield typed partial or truncated outcomes and prevents an all-upstream-records claim.
A missing parsed band/DOS artifact is not evidence that the source has no spectrum.
prohibited_claims: Do not report a universal MoS2 band gap or a phase-resolved MoS2 gap answer, merge records by formula, infer a shared 2H bulk, 1H monolayer, or other phase without explicit structure matching, count COD/CODX experimental structures as experimental band-gap observations, or treat retrieval/rendering as independent experimental validation.
